policy: adapter_structure > user_block > adapter_semantic_negative > successful_request > complete_inventory_negative > user_allow > collector_positive
notes: Partial or unknown inventory may prove support, but cannot prove a missing model is unsupported.
Generic 403/404 adapter statuses are uncertain and do not become model unsupported without a semantic adapter signal.
Strict policy changes admission for Unknown only; it does not rewrite evidence truth.
